headline: Law lets the VA build a major medical facility project in St. Louis, Missouri, during fiscal year 2026, with a spending cap.
what_it_does: This law gives the Department of Veterans Affairs permission to carry out a major medical facility project in St. Louis, Missouri, during fiscal year 2026. The project includes a new bed tower, an expanded clinical building, a combined office building and warehouse, a utility plant, and parking garages. The law also sets the most money that can be spent on the project.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who get health care from the VA in the St. Louis area
who_it_affects.how: The project is meant to add a new bed tower and expand clinical space at the VA medical facility serving them.
The VA is authorized to carry out the construction project but must stay under the spending limit set in the law.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted June 9, 2026; the project is authorized for fiscal year 2026.
